review: Merged the published 2026-11-03 nightly into a work branch, following upstream's horizon-client-lib split. The render, client-lib and horizon-android crates pass a host cargo check with --no-default-features; Android-target builds, GPU runs and device runs are not done. Android renderer pieces re-applied on upstream's pipeline cache and opaque/cutout split: compatibility and mobile gating, GLES terrain shaders, frame scale and scaled presentation, suspend and surface handling, replacement context, Mali run coalescing, GLES panorama and the Pvp/Touch/Skin settings. Taken from upstream, so the Android versions are not carried over: shader-pack GLES fixes in pack_post.rs, the mesher's interior-leaf culling and face bits, the menu-blur cache and downscale (the blur now uses upstream's half-size mode on Android), the paged pack browser, Polytone particles and tinting in the mesher, and the Android anvil tweak. Nine Android launcher-overhaul tests that assert those features currently fail and list what remains to port. Kept deployment workflows disabled.
